日文.首段: 富山地方鉄道14720形電車（とやまちほうてつどう14720がたでんしゃ）は、1962年に登場した富山地方鉄道（地鉄）の電車。

章节.概要: 1962年にモハ14721・モハ14722の2両が日本車輌製造（日車）で製造された。10020形とほぼ同形で、10020形はMM'ユニット車であるのに対し、本形式は単独走行可能な1M方式である点と、主電動機の出力が高くなっている点が主な相違点である。製造当初はモハ14721-サハ222-モハ14722の3両編成であったが、1969年にサハ222はクハ170形172に改造され、モハ14721-クハ171・モハ14722-クハ172という2両編成2本の陣容となった。
章节.車体: モハ10020形とほぼ同じ、全長18 mの2扉車である。側面のデザインは、日本車輌が同時期に製造した名鉄5500系電車や長野電鉄2000系電車と似通っている。前面は2枚窓で、前照灯は窓上の中央と両端に3灯が配されている。塗色は登場当初、下半分が濃い橙、上半分が薄い橙であったが、その後白地に窓周りが薄い灰色で、窓下に赤の帯を入れる塗装になった。
章节.主要機器: 主電動機は東洋電機製造製の定格出力110 kW・端子電圧750 VのTDK803-Aを1両に付き4個搭載しており、10020形の75 kWに比べ出力アップが図られている。台車は、日車製の空気ばね台車・NA-307を装備している。
章节.内装: 車内の客席は、扉間にクロスシート、車端部にロングシートを配したセミクロスシートである。
章节.沿革:
1969年5月24日～29日に富山県で行われた全国植樹祭では、3両編成でお召し列車として運用された。その際には、サハ222の車内の椅子を一部取り外し、ソファとテーブルを設置した。列車の前後には日章旗が取り付けられた。お召し列車として運行されたのは28日で、往路は岩峅寺駅から千寿ヶ原駅（現在の立山駅）まで、復路は千寿ヶ原駅から電鉄富山駅までであった。
2011年12月に全国公開された映画『RAILWAYS 愛を伝えられない大人たちへ』では、主人公・滝島徹（三浦友和）が車掌として、吉原満（米倉斉加年）が運転士として乗務したという設定になっていた。
モハ14721は1986年、モハ14722は1987年に冷房化が行われ、あわせてヘッドライト2灯化・車体裾（台枠）部の直線化（絞りなし）・貫通路の狭幅化・手ブレーキ装置の撤去などの改造も行われた。その後ワンマン化改造も行われている。モハ14721は、さらにその後上半分が黄色・下半分が緑の新塗装とされている。
14721編成は2012年に火災による焼損（次項参照）で廃車となり、14722編成も2019年12月21日をもって引退した。引退に際し、鉄道線全線を走破する特別イベントが実施された。その後、翌2020年1月に解体のため10020形と共に搬出された。
章节.火災による焼損: 2012年1月4日午前、立山駅に停車していた（電鉄富山駅行き）の14721編成（モハ14721-クハ171の2両編成）のうち、先頭車両であるモハ14721の床下から火が出て、同車両の床下中央部の機器を焼損する事故が発生した。乗客・乗員6名に怪我はなかった。積雪による抵抗で主電動機に高負荷がかかり、それによって主抵抗器が高温となったのが原因とされている。事故車両は2013年9月18日に上市駅に移送され、そこから伏木のリサイクル工場へトレーラーで搬出され解体された。

中文.词条标题: 富山地方铁道14720型电力动车组
中文.首段: 富山地方铁道14720型电力动车组（とやまちほうてつどう14720がたでんしゃ）是富山地方铁道（地铁）于1962年投入使用的电力动车组。

章节.概要: 1962年，モハ14721、モハ14722两节车厢由日本车辆制造（日车）制造。本型与10020型几乎同型，10020型为MM'单元车，而本型则可单独运行，采用1M方式，且主电动机输出功率更高，这是主要差异。制造之初为モハ14721-サハ222-モハ14722的三节编组，但1969年サハ222被改造为クハ170型172，于是形成モハ14721-クハ171、モハ14722-クハ172两节编组共两组的阵容。
章节.车体: 与モハ10020型几乎相同，为全长18 m的双门车。侧面的设计与日本车辆同时期制造的名铁5500系电力动车组及长野电铁2000系电力动车组相似。车头为两片窗，前照灯在窗上方中央及两端共布置3盏。涂色在登场之初为下半部分深橙色、上半部分浅橙色，此后改为白底、窗周浅灰色，窗下加红色带条的涂装。
章节.主要设备: 主电动机采用东洋电机制造的额定输出110 kW、端子电压750 V的TDK803-A，每节车厢搭载4台，相较10020型的75 kW提高了输出功率。转向架装备日本车辆制造的空気弹簧转向架NA-307。
章节.内装: 车内客座为门间设交叉式座椅、车端部设长条座椅的半交叉式座椅。
章节.沿革:
1969年5月24日～29日在富山县举行的全国植树节上，以三节编组作为御召列车运用。当时拆除了サハ222车内的一部分座椅，设置了沙发和桌子。列车前后悬挂了日章旗。作为御召列车运行的是28日，去程为岩峅寺站至千寿ヶ原站（现立山站），回程为千寿ヶ原站至电铁富山站。
2011年12月全国公映的电影《RAILWAYS 给无法传达爱的大人们》中，设定为主角滝岛彻（三浦友和）作为列车员、吉原满（米仓齐加年）作为司机乘务。
モハ14721于1986年、モハ14722于1987年进行了冷气化改造，同时还进行了前照灯双灯化、车体裙部（底架）直线化（无收束）、贯通路窄幅化、手制动装置拆除等改造。此后还进行了单人运转化改造。モハ14721此后更进一步改为上半部分黄色、下半部分绿色的新涂装。
14721编组于2012年因火灾烧损（参见下节）而报废，14722编组也于2019年12月21日引退。引退之际，实施了跑遍铁路线全线的特别活动。此后，于翌年2020年1月与10020型一同被搬出以便解体。
章节.因火灾烧损: 2012年1月4日上午，停靠在立山站（开往电铁富山站方向）的14721编组（モハ14721-クハ171两节编组）中，头节车厢モハ14721的车下起火，造成该车厢车下中央部设备烧损的事故。乘客及乘务人员共6人无人受伤。据称原因是积雪造成的阻力使主电动机承受高负荷，从而导致主电阻器高温。事故车辆于2013年9月18日被移送至上市站，再从那里用拖车搬出至伏木的回收工厂解体。

英文.词条标题: Toyama Chihō Railway 14720 series electric multiple unit
英文.首段: The Toyama Chihō Railway 14720 series electric multiple unit (とやまちほうてつどう14720がたでんしゃ) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) of Toyama Chihō Railway (Chitetsu) that entered service in 1962.

章节.Overview: In 1962, two cars, Moha 14721 and Moha 14722, were built by Nippon Sharyo (Nishasha). The type is nearly identical to the 10020 series; whereas the 10020 series is an MM' unit car, the main differences of this type are that it can run alone on a 1M system and that its traction motors have higher output. At the time of construction it formed a three-car set of Moha 14721 - Saha 222 - Moha 14722, but in 1969 Saha 222 was rebuilt into Kuha 170-172, resulting in a fleet of two two-car sets, Moha 14721 - Kuha 171 and Moha 14722 - Kuha 172.
章节.Body: Like the Moha 10020 series, it is an 18 m long two-door car. The side design resembles the Meitetsu 5500 series and Nagano Electric Railway 2000 series that Nippon Sharyo built around the same time. The front has two windows, with three headlights arranged at the center above the windows and at both ends. The livery at introduction was dark orange on the lower half and light orange on the upper half; later it became a white base with light gray around the windows and a red band below the windows.
章节.Main equipment: Each car is equipped with four TDK803-A traction motors made by Toyo Denki Seizo, rated at 110 kW with a terminal voltage of 750 V, increasing output compared with the 75 kW of the 10020 series. The bogies are air-spring bogies, NA-307, made by Nippon Sharyo.
章节.Interior: The passenger seating is semi-cross seating, with cross seats between the doors and longitudinal seats at the car ends.
章节.History:
At the National Tree-planting Festival held in Toyama Prefecture from May 24 to 29, 1969, it was operated as an imperial train in a three-car formation. On that occasion some of the seats in Saha 222 were removed and sofas and tables were installed. Japanese national flags were attached to the front and rear of the train. It ran as an imperial train on the 28th; the outbound run was from Iwakuraji Station to Senjugahara Station (present-day Tateyama Station), and the return run was from Senjugahara Station to Dentetsu-Toyama Station.
In the film "RAILWAYS: Ai o Tsutaerarenai Otonatachi e," released nationwide in December 2011, the setting was that the protagonist Toru Takishima (Tomokazu Miura) served as conductor and Mitsuru Yoshihara (Saikane Yonekura) as driver.
Moha 14721 was air-conditioned in 1986 and Moha 14722 in 1987, and at the same time modifications were made, including twin headlights, straightening of the body skirt (underframe) portion (no tapering), narrowing of the gangway, and removal of the handbrake device. One-man operation conversion was also carried out afterwards. Moha 14721 was later repainted in a new livery with the upper half yellow and the lower half green.
The 14721 set was scrapped in 2012 due to fire damage (see the next section), and the 14722 set was retired as of December 21, 2019. On the occasion of its retirement, a special event was held in which it ran over the entire railway line. Afterwards, in January of the following year, 2020, it was removed together with the 10020 series for dismantling.
章节.Fire damage: On the morning of January 4, 2012, fire broke out from under the floor of the leading car Moha 14721 of the 14721 set (a two-car set of Moha 14721 - Kuha 171) that was stopped at Tateyama Station (bound for Dentetsu-Toyama Station), causing an accident in which the equipment in the center under the floor of that car was burned. None of the six passengers and crew were injured. The cause is said to be that resistance from accumulated snow placed a heavy load on the traction motors, which in turn made the main resistor hot. The accident car was transferred to Kamiichi Station on September 18, 2013, and from there was hauled out by trailer to a recycling plant in Fushiki and dismantled.

英文.全文:
The Toyama Chihō Railway 14720 series electric multiple unit (とやまちほうてつどう14720がたでんしゃ) is an electric multiple unit (EMU) of Toyama Chihō Railway (Chitetsu) that entered service in 1962.

== Overview ==
In 1962, two cars, Moha 14721 and Moha 14722, were built by Nippon Sharyo (Nishasha). The type is nearly identical to the 10020 series; whereas the 10020 series is an MM' unit car, the main differences of this type are that it can run alone on a 1M system and that its traction motors have higher output. At the time of construction it formed a three-car set of Moha 14721 - Saha 222 - Moha 14722, but in 1969 Saha 222 was rebuilt into Kuha 170-172, resulting in a fleet of two two-car sets, Moha 14721 - Kuha 171 and Moha 14722 - Kuha 172.

== Structure ==

=== Body ===
Like the Moha 10020 series, it is an 18 m long two-door car. The side design resembles the Meitetsu 5500 series and Nagano Electric Railway 2000 series that Nippon Sharyo built around the same time. The front has two windows, with three headlights arranged at the center above the windows and at both ends. The livery at introduction was dark orange on the lower half and light orange on the upper half; later it became a white base with light gray around the windows and a red band below the windows.

=== Main equipment ===
Each car is equipped with four TDK803-A traction motors made by Toyo Denki Seizo, rated at 110 kW with a terminal voltage of 750 V, increasing output compared with the 75 kW of the 10020 series. The bogies are air-spring bogies, NA-307, made by Nippon Sharyo.

=== Interior ===
The passenger seating is semi-cross seating, with cross seats between the doors and longitudinal seats at the car ends.

== History ==
At the National Tree-planting Festival held in Toyama Prefecture from May 24 to 29, 1969, it was operated as an imperial train in a three-car formation. On that occasion some of the seats in Saha 222 were removed and sofas and tables were installed. Japanese national flags were attached to the front and rear of the train. It ran as an imperial train on the 28th; the outbound run was from Iwakuraji Station to Senjugahara Station (present-day Tateyama Station), and the return run was from Senjugahara Station to Dentetsu-Toyama Station.
In the film "RAILWAYS: Ai o Tsutaerarenai Otonatachi e," released nationwide in December 2011, the setting was that the protagonist Toru Takishima (Tomokazu Miura) served as conductor and Mitsuru Yoshihara (Saikane Yonekura) as driver.
Moha 14721 was air-conditioned in 1986 and Moha 14722 in 1987, and at the same time modifications were made, including twin headlights, straightening of the body skirt (underframe) portion (no tapering), narrowing of the gangway, and removal of the handbrake device. One-man operation conversion was also carried out afterwards. Moha 14721 was later repainted in a new livery with the upper half yellow and the lower half green.
The 14721 set was scrapped in 2012 due to fire damage (see the next section), and the 14722 set was retired as of December 21, 2019. On the occasion of its retirement, a special event was held in which it ran over the entire railway line. Afterwards, in January of the following year, 2020, it was removed together with the 10020 series for dismantling.

=== Fire damage ===
On the morning of January 4, 2012, fire broke out from under the floor of the leading car Moha 14721 of the 14721 set (a two-car set of Moha 14721 - Kuha 171) that was stopped at Tateyama Station (bound for Dentetsu-Toyama Station), causing an accident in which the equipment in the center under the floor of that car was burned. None of the six passengers and crew were injured. The cause is said to be that resistance from accumulated snow placed a heavy load on the traction motors, which in turn made the main resistor hot. The accident car was transferred to Kamiichi Station on September 18, 2013, and from there was hauled out by trailer to a recycling plant in Fushiki and dismantled.
